content:
AlexR: quick heads-up — planning a small kernel ABI bump tonight in the quiet window (00:30-01:30 UTC). need agreement on pin/hold strategy and rollback triggers. :wave:
PriyaQ: copy. what slices are we touching? staging only or gradual prod slice?
AlexR: staging -> 10% prod -> 50% -> 100% if green. main risk is quantized matmul perf regression we've seen in last run.
Ben: re: pin: i'd like a sticky pin on the old engine for 2h post-swap, so we can force-rollback if telemetry shows perf regressions. TTL 2h ok?
Carla: 2h sounds fine. also request to emit a named metric for "engine.swap.latency_p95" and add a smoke eval set to run after each slice.
Ming: infra note: deploy-bot only supports pin TTL as minutes. will map 2h -> 120m. also need to ensure driver variant mapping is in deploy manifest.
AlexR: good — i'll add driver mapping to the release manifest. Deploy commands i'll run:```/deploy swap --from=engine-v8-unsigned --to=engine-v9-abi --slice=staging```then```/deploy slice --percent=10 --note="night-quiet-window"```
SamOncall: please add me to the watchlist and enable slack alerts for p95 > baseline*1.2 and OOM rate increase > 0.1%. i'll be oncall during window.
Jonah: release-notes draft: "engine v9 ABI bump — fixes kernel scheduling and enables new matmul kernels; progressive rollout with safety pins. See internal RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc-engine-v9"
deply-bot correction: (typo) -> deploy-bot
Carla: also, can we ensure the canary has KV cache warmstart enabled? last time cold start skewed latency numbers.
AlexR: yes will set warmstart=true for staging slice. command in manifest: ```engine_flags: { "kv_warmstart": true }```
PriyaQ: QA will run the following smoke prompt set after each slice: `smoke_eval_v1.json` — will post results to #eng-runtime-evals. pass criteria: p95 latency within 15% and no degradation in exact-match rerank tests.
Ben: rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback if p95>baseline*1.5 or error-rate delta > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets. manual rollback if QA flags fail or customer-facing errors reported.
Ming: note for deploy-bot: pin command to use:```/deploy pin engine=engine-v8-unsigned ttl=120m reason="post-swap safeguard"``` and unpin command on success:```/deploy unpin engine=engine-v8-unsigned```
deploy-bot: Scheduled swap queued by AlexR. Preflight checks: checksum OK, driver-mapping present, manifests baked. Next step: run staging swap when AlexR triggers.
SamOncall: i'll monitor infra dashboard, set alert thresholds, and stand by. tagging @oncall for visibility.
Jonah: i'll prepare RN summary and email ops before cutover. also will add a short note for customers on the Dedicated slack channel about the maintenance window.
AlexR: thanks — timeline: 00:25 preflight, 00:30 staging swap, 00:45 10% prod, 01:05 50% prod, 01:25 100% prod, 01:30 unpin/cleanup if green. rolling back plan documented in the release manifest. :thumbsup:
PriyaQ: ack, will post smoke results after each step.
Ben: if anything looks off we trigger `/deploy rollback --target=engine-v8-unsigned --reason="perf-regression"` and pin stays.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy-bot will auto-cancel staged slices if manual rollback is issued. See `/deploy help`.
Carla: leaving this thread open until post-cleanup — i'll make a checklist and paste it here before the window.
AlexR: perfect — thanks everyone.
